question.ask: How many turnovers still need scheduling?
question.whyItMatters: The host books the cleaner a week ahead.

text.text: Your rentals in one place. Check Bookings arriving today and this week, make sure every Turnover has a cleaner, and keep Issues from reaching guests. Operational tracking only.
Reliable turnovers are what guests and reviews depend on.
Press Add turnover on the booking.
Pick the cleaner and the clean date: the check-out day.
Share the booking details and any special requests.
Cleaner uploads photos and marks the turnover Cleaned.
Anything broken becomes an Issue before the next guest arrives.
On booking: welcome and house rules.
Three days before: check-in instructions and local tips.
Day of arrival: confirmation that the place is ready.
After checkout: thanks and a review request.
Keep messages short, warm and specific to the guest.
Guest-impacting: fix or offer an alternative the same day.
Routine: batch with the next visit.
Take a photo and log it.
Mark Fixed and record the cost.
Review payouts by channel and rental
